description: Pay-per-call SINCOR feeds for agent builders: live Base ETH/USD monitor price, unsigned solver quotes from public Base pool state, and ERC-8004 validation/reputation lookups. MCP tools are free to call locally; the companion HTTP gateway serves the first 10 calls/day free, then an x402 HTTP 402 challenge at 0.01 USDC on Base with a 500 bps platform fee, settled through the sincor-x402 package's labelled local-reference rail (no mainnet settlement yet).
displayName: SINCOR — Price Feed, Solver Quotes, ERC-8004 Oracle

honesty.oracle: interface level — SincorValidationReputationOracle is NOT deployed on Base mainnet; default backend is the real compiled contract on an in-process local chain with labelled demo seed data
honesty.settlement: local-reference only — sincor-x402==0.1.0 labelled reference facilitator/escrow; NOT on-chain; no mainnet settlement until the founder's CDP facilitator decision lands
honesty.solver: quotes are unsigned paper measurements from public pool state (signed: false, signature: null); nothing can be submitted from a quote
